verdict.rationale: Gide's own Venture & Growth Tech page says it advises both investors and entrepreneurs on negotiating financing documentation from seed to IPO, and a Chambers Band 1 quote praises its understanding of market practices, so the two-sided core of the story is documented. The evidence does not show fund-side representation such as venture fund formation, and every item is first-party. missing for 10: explicit evidence of representing venture funds as clients (fund formation/LP work), named investor-side deal references, independent corroboration of current market-terms knowledge (e.g. published term benchmarks)

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the firm also represents venture funds and investors, so it knows current market terms from both sides of the table

citations.quote: We support venture capitalists, both investors and entrepreneurs, in all their transactions and at all stages of a growth company's development, from fundraising to exit.
We advise entrepreneurs and investors on structuring, negotiating and drafting all documentation for financing transactions, from seed capital to IPOs.
They have a very good understanding of market practices and are responsive.
On average, we oversee more than 70 transactions a year, amounting to more than €9.2 billion raised or invested by our clients over the past 18 years.
